editorial:
Imagine living in a world where you cannot trust your own eyes. You follow Danika, a mom who is trying her best to keep her life together, but she is plagued by scary visions that feel way too real. After a fake bank robbery makes her quit her job, things only get weirder. Even though her husband and kids are super supportive, she feels like she is losing her mind. The movie feels like a slow burn that keeps you guessing if she is actually sick or if something truly evil is happening around her. It is a creepy ride that makes you feel her panic as she tries to protect her family from things only she can see.

The acting is solid, and the way the mystery unfolds keeps you glued to the screen. One big plus is how the movie builds tension without relying on cheap jump scares. The pacing is a bit slow at first, but the payoff makes it worth the wait. If you love psychological puzzles, you should definitely check this out. You can grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection to see all the details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. It is a great pick for a rainy weekend when you want something that messes with your head.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that Danika is not just imagining things. She discovers that she is part of a dark cycle of trauma and supernatural influence. The movie ends with a shocking realization that her fears about her children were grounded in a scary reality. After a final confrontation, you see that the cycle of violence is hard to break, leaving you with a chilling feeling as the credits roll.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves movies about people losing their grip on reality.
